test_cases.name: Sign in with valid credentials
test_cases.description: User successfully signs into YouTube using a valid Google account.

steps.details: Click the 'Sign in' button to navigate to the sign-in page.
Enter valid email/username and password on the sign-in form.

selectors.description: Navigates to the sign-in page from the main YouTube page.

test_cases.name: Attempt to sign in with invalid credentials
test_cases.description: User attempts to sign into YouTube using an invalid Google account.

steps.details: Click the 'Sign in' button to navigate to the sign-in page.
Enter invalid email/username and password on the sign-in form.
Click 'Next' to attempt authentication with invalid credentials.

selectors.description: Navigates to the sign-in page from the main YouTube page.

test_cases.name: Navigate to Home from main page
test_cases.description: User navigates back to the home page of YouTube.

steps.details: Click the 'Home' button to navigate back to the main YouTube page.

selectors.description: Navigates to the home page from any other page on YouTube.

coverage_summary: This set of test cases covers basic navigation and sign-in functionality. It includes a valid sign-in scenario, an invalid sign-in attempt for negative testing, and a navigation back to the home page from any other page. Additional tests could explore more complex user flows and error handling.
